recent_articles.title: NEET UG Retest June 21 in pen and paper mode: NTA briefs parliament panel amid fresh political storm
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A parliamentary committee meeting examining pen-and-paper versus computer-based testing systems devolved into a political debate over the June 21 NEET-UG retest. **Digvijaya Singh**, chair of the committee, expressed concern about Prime Minister Narendra Modi's personal accountability for preventing another paper leak.  **NTA officials** defended their plan to conduct the re-examination in pen-and-paper format and assured the panel that adequate safeguards were in place. The committee also prevented representatives from a doctors’ body, **United Doctors Front**, from presenting their concerns regarding the NEET-UG examination process.

recent_articles.title: Trump's $1.8 Billion 'Weaponization' Payout Put On Hold After Backlash
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **President Donald Trump's** nearly $1.8 billion victim compensation fund, aimed at compensating individuals who alleged government "weaponization," has been put on hold after facing opposition from **Republican senators**. The fund was halted due to concerns over payouts to January 6th Capitol attackers and a lack of support from the White House.  The Justice Department, under acting Attorney General Todd Blanche, is currently reviewing the situation, with some sources suggesting it may be permanently scrapped. Senate Majority Leader John Thune has called for the fund's termination while House Speaker Mike Johnson also participated in discussions about the matter.

recent_articles.title: Five new Supreme Court judges sworn in - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Supreme Court** of India welcomed five new judges on Tuesday, June 2nd, 2026, increasing its total strength to 37.  These appointments follow the Union government's increase in sanctioned judges from 33 to 37, aimed at addressing a backlog of over 93,000 cases. The newly appointed judges include **Sheel Nagu**, former Chief Justice of Punjab and Haryana High Court; **Shree Chandrashekhar**, former Chief Justice of Bombay High Court; **Sanjeev Sachdeva**, former Chief Justice of Madhya Pradesh High Court; **Arun Palli**, former Chief Justice of High Court of Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh; and Senior Advocate **V.S. Mohana**.  The appointments are part of a larger effort to balance regional representation and improve gender diversity on the Bench, as well as address the court's backlog of cases.

recent_articles.title: US justice department halts 'anti-weaponisation' fund after court ruling
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **US Department of Justice (DOJ)** announced it will abide by a court ruling halting the Trump administration's $1.8 billion "anti-weaponization" fund, which was intended to compensate individuals alleging unfair treatment by previous administrations. The DOJ disagrees with the decision and maintains the fund was created to address abuse and harm suffered by many people regardless of political affiliation.  The judge temporarily blocked the fund until a hearing on June 12th after two men alleged discrimination in its eligibility criteria. Several Republican lawmakers, Democrats, and even former Vice President Mike Pence have voiced opposition to the fund, calling it a "slush fund" and urging its discontinuation.

recent_articles.title: ‘Cow not animal, it’s revered as mother’: Yogi Adityanath asks clerics to caution followers against any disrespect | Lucknow News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Yogi Adityanath**, the **Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh**, criticized those who disrespect cows, demanding that Muslim clerics caution their followers against such behavior. He also addressed recent incidents of violence and religious persecution, accusing some religious leaders of double standards for not speaking out on behalf of victims displaced by Partition.  He praised Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** and Home Minister **Amit Shah** for the Citizenship Amendment Act (CAA) and criticized opposition parties for opposing it while accusing them of supporting illegal infiltration. He distributed land ownership certificates to families displaced from Pakistan, highlighting their struggle against religious extremism.

recent_articles.title: From Shakhas to Cabinet: The RSS Loyalists in Camp Suvendu Adhikari | Kolkata News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The newly sworn-in **BJP** cabinet in West Bengal features a number of leaders who rose through the ranks of the **Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS)**.  These individuals, including Tapas Roy, Dudh Kumar Mondal, Gouri Shankar Ghosh, Dipak Barman, Dr Ajay Poddar, Dr Sharadwat Mukherjee, Manoj Kumar Oraon, Arup Kumar Das, and Malati Rava Roy, have a history of working within the party's grassroots organization.  Roy, Mondal, Ghosh, Barman, Poddar, Mukherjee, Oraon, Das, and Roy all previously held positions in local bodies or as MLAs before joining the cabinet.

recent_articles.title: BJP picks old RSS hand Nagendra Nath Tripathi for outreach to ‘neglected’ Sangh Parivar elders | Political Pulse News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **BJP** has appointed **Nagendra Nath Tripathi**, a long-time RSS and BJP member, as the national organiser for outreach to senior Sangh Parivar workers.  Tripathi’s extensive organizational experience spans decades across the RSS, ABVP, and BJP, and he is expected to lead efforts to reconnect veteran workers who have been feeling neglected due to the party's focus on other priorities. The initiative aims to strengthen coordination between the BJP and the larger Sangh Parivar while recognizing the contributions of long-serving members.

recent_articles.title: Why Himachal local body poll results come as boost to BJP despite CM Sukhu’s ‘local factors’ argument | Political Pulse News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Saurabh Parashar**, an Assistant Editor at **The Indian Express**, focuses on the socio-political landscape of Himachal Pradesh, particularly environmental issues, drug menace, and governance challenges. He has over 17 years of experience in print media, specializing in crime, legal affairs, and investigative reporting.  His recent articles have explored the impact of policy on social safety nets, the conflict between development and forest conservation, and the unique challenges of governance in high-altitude regions. **Parashar** is known for his tenacious reporting on the state's drug epidemic and his deep understanding of Himachal Pradesh's geography and tribal culture.

recent_articles.title: Trump inserts himself into America's 250th birthday celebrations
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Donald Trump** has asserted his presence in the celebration of America's 250th birthday, directing his administration to replace musical acts with a "giant Make America Great Again Rally" at the National Mall. This move follows his frequent attempts to center himself on historic national events since returning to office in January 2025, including the World Cup and the upcoming Olympics.  The **Freedom 250** committee, backed by Trump, is hosting a series of events, while **America 250**, overseen by Congress, focuses on smaller-scale art exhibits and block parties. The president's focus on beautification projects in Washington has drawn criticism from some who see it as inappropriate for the occasion.

recent_articles.title: Doctors’ body barred from Parliamentary panel meeting on NEET after BJP objections - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **United Doctors Front (UDF)** representatives were barred from testifying before the Parliamentary Standing Committee on Education, chaired by **Digvijaya Singh**, after protests from **BJP** MPs. The committee was convened to discuss issues related to the National Eligibility-cum-Entrance Test-Undergraduate (NEET-UG) examination and the functioning of the **National Testing Agency (NTA)**, which has been under scrutiny for alleged paper leaks.  The UDF, which is demanding the dissolution of the NTA, had submitted names of its representatives and a memorandum of demands in advance but was ultimately excluded from the meeting.

recent_articles.title: Celebration, shock and scepticism follow Colombia’s presidential election | Elections News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Abelardo de la Espriella**, a far-right lawyer, won the Colombian presidential election in the first round, surprising pollsters and upending expectations.  He secured 43.74% of the vote, defeating **Ivan Cepeda**, a leftist senator who had been predicted to win. De la Espriella's victory highlights growing anti-establishment sentiment and a shift in Colombia's political landscape. The election results have drawn criticism from outgoing President **Gustavo Petro**, who has called for a thorough review of the preliminary vote count before accepting the outcome.  A second round of voting is scheduled for June 21, where de la Espriella will face Cepeda.

recent_articles.title: R. Balasubramaniam feted on appointment to NITI Aayog - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Swami Vivekananda Youth Movement (SVYM)** and **Grassroots Research and Advocacy Movement (GRAAM)** jointly organized a program in Mysuru to celebrate the appointment of R. Balasubramaniam as a full-time member of **NITI Aayog**.  The event, titled 'Celebrating Grassroots Leadership in National Building', featured speakers who recalled SVYM's early years and Dr. Balasubramaniam's journey from grassroots activism to government service. He emphasized the need for renewed custodianship, active citizenship, and regenerative development for India's growth. The program also included a panel discussion on Mysuru 2050: Cultural, Inclusive, Sustainable and Competitive Development of the City.

recent_articles.title: CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke interview: 'Cockroach Janta Party now transitioning into a movement' - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Abhijeet Dipke**, founder of the **Cockroach Janta Party (CJP)**, announced plans to return to India on June 6th and stage a peaceful protest at Jantar Mantar in New Delhi.  Dipke stated that CJP will continue using satire and other means to advocate for the resignation of **Dharmendra Pradhan**, Union Education Minister, as over eight lakh signatures have been collected on a petition hosted on their website.

recent_articles.title: AP cadre IAS officer A. Vani Prasad reallocated to Telangana cadre - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Department of Personnel and Training (DoPT)** has ordered the **Andhra Pradesh government** to immediately relieve senior IAS officer A. Vani Prasad from her current position in the state cadre and relocate her to the Telangana cadre as directed by a **Telangana High Court** ruling. The court's decision stems from an order requiring the officer, originally from the combined Andhra Pradesh cadre before the state bifurcation, to be transferred to the Telangana cadre.

recent_articles.title: Himachal CM Sukhu presents ₹54,928-crore budget for 2026-27 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Himachal Pradesh** Chief Minister Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu presented a ₹54,928-crore budget for the 2026-27 fiscal year in the state assembly.  Sukhu accused the **BJP** of not supporting the state's interests and criticized the discontinuation of the revenue deficit grant (RDG). The opposition **BJP** members reacted with slogans, prompting the speaker to adjourn the session. Sukhu announced a ₹500-crore allocation for completing pending works and increased milk procurement prices.

recent_articles.title: SMOKERS’ CORNER: THE MYTH OF UNITY - Newspaper - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Political analysts argue that a formal rapprochement between the military, government, and Imran Khan is necessary for Pakistan's national unity amidst security threats. However, experts caution against concessions to a populist leader like Khan, citing historical examples of appeasement leading to instability. The 27th Amendment to the Constitution has strengthened the state's authority by centralizing military command and establishing a federal constitutional court, discouraging informal deals with political personalities.  The current government and military establishment believe that national unity should be based on support for the state, not individual leaders, and that seeking dialogue through formal channels is crucial during times of crisis.

recent_articles.title: SMOKERS’ CORNER: THE MYTH OF UNITY - Newspaper - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Political analysts are suggesting a formal rapprochement between the military establishment, government, and Imran Khan is the only viable path forward for Pakistan. They argue that national unity is crucial to address mounting security threats from India, Islamist militants, and Baloch separatists. However, the government and military establishment believe granting concessions to Khan would undermine their authority and create a precedent for future political actors to exploit instability for personal gain.  They view the 27th Amendment, which centralizes military command under the Chief of Defence Forces, as a step towards strengthening the state's position and preventing further internal appeasement. They argue that national unity should be based on support for the state, government, and Constitution rather than a specific political personality. This approach is seen as more effective in addressing Pakistan's current challenges than seeking dialogue with Khan.

recent_articles.title: Tripura Government accommodating fake private universities, Opposition alleges - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **CPI(M)** and **Congress** members in the Tripura Assembly staged a walkout after bills were passed to establish three private universities.  **Sudip Roy Barman**, **Congress** leader, accused the government of engaging in suspicious financial corruption by allowing "bogus" institutions to operate. **Jitendra Chowdhury**, leader of the Opposition, alleged that the addresses and contact numbers provided by the applicants were not genuine, with one university's phone number belonging to a plywood factory. The bills are set to be introduced for another private university called "Dhanvantari University".

recent_articles.title: Bill to fund US homeland security fails again as concern grows about airport lines | US news | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Senate** failed to advance a bill funding the **Department of Homeland Security** due to disagreements over immigration enforcement practices. **Chuck Schumer**, the Democratic leader, proposed an alternative measure that would fund only the **Transportation Security Administration**.  Senator Susan Collins, chair of the Senate appropriations committee, stated that the White House has made a "fair and reasonable" offer in hopes of resolving the standoff, but Democrats are demanding policy changes including warrant requirements for ICE agents. The impasse has led to TSA funding being stalled, causing long lines at airports and impacting TSA employees who are working without pay.

recent_articles.title: As per provision, Nitish Kumar can remain CM for next six months: Bihar Minister Sharwan Kumar - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Bihar Chief Minister Nitish Kumar** can remain in office for the next six months despite being elected to the **Rajya Sabha**, according to **Bihar Rural Development Minister Sharwan Kumar**.  Kumar will resign from his seat in the Bihar Legislative Council within 14 days. The decision on his successor is expected to be made soon, with **Deputy Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary** considered a frontrunner by some prominent figures including **Jitan Ram Manjhi**, Union Minister and founder of Hindustani Awam Morcha (Secular).  The ongoing Samriddhi Yatra will continue in the coming weeks.

recent_articles.title: Azharuddin greets people of TG on Eid - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mohammad Azharuddin**, Minister for Minority Welfare, expressed optimism that the upcoming Eid-ul-Fitr festival will bring happiness and progress to the people of Telangana. He highlighted the importance of shared celebration and empathy during Ramadan, emphasizing the state's strong tradition of unity and harmony in celebrating various festivals. **A. Revanth Reddy**, the Chief Minister, has been instrumental in strengthening secular values within the state, as evidenced by his commitment to providing equal opportunities for all citizens.

recent_articles.title: Crucial meeting scheduled in Delhi to shortlist DGP candidates for Tamil Nadu deferred - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A meeting in Delhi to shortlist three Director General of Police-rank officers for the Tamil Nadu police has been postponed due to administrative reasons. The **State Chief Secretary**, **Home Secretary**, and representatives from the **Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)** were scheduled to meet on March 20, 2026, to finalize a list of three eligible candidates.  The meeting was called after the State government submitted a revised proposal for DGP-rank officers in Level-16 pay scale. The Supreme Court had previously directed the Tamil Nadu government to submit its proposal within one week and finalize a panel of three officers within two weeks.

recent_articles.title: Investigate incidents of black magic carried near Ajit Pawar’s home: Rohit Pawar - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rohit Pawar**, leader of the NCP (SP), demanded an inquiry into alleged black magic incidents outside the residences of late Maharashtra deputy chief minister **Ajit Pawar**.  He cited MLA **Amol G. Mitkari's** claims about black magic performed at Ajit Pawar's Sahayog Society and a separate incident in Nashik involving self-styled godman **Ashok Kharat**. Pawar questioned the mastermind behind these acts, including whether **Kharat** was involved and if so, who commissioned the task.

recent_articles.title: Vivek Ramaswamy spent $12,000 in campaign funds on luxury Puerto Rico trip ahead of H1-B conference: Report - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Vivek Ramaswamy**, a billionaire and Indian-American gubernatorial candidate, spent nearly $12,000 in campaign funds on a luxury trip to Puerto Rico. Records show the **campaign** paid for a one-bedroom suite at the Dorado Beach Ritz-Carlton Reserve, citing travel as the purpose. The trip took place ahead of the ITServe Alliance Synergy annual conference where Ramaswamy was scheduled to deliver a keynote speech advocating for changes to H-1B visa policies. He withdrew from the conference shortly before it began after facing online criticism over the organization's stance on immigration.

recent_articles.title: RFK Jr overstepped in declaring gender-affirming treatments unsafe, judge rules | Robert F Kennedy Jr | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A federal judge ruled that **Robert F Kennedy Jr**, the health secretary, overstepped his authority by issuing a declaration claiming gender-affirming treatments are unsafe for children and adolescents. The ruling granted relief to doctors providing these treatments and dismissed the government's attempts to dismiss the case brought by 21 states and Washington DC.  The judge stated that **Kennedy** did not follow proper procedures before publishing the declaration, questioning his actions and their implications for democratic governance.

recent_articles.title: Democrats outraged as Fetterman votes to advance Markwayne Mullin nomination | Democrats | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **John Fetterman**, the senior US senator from Pennsylvania, voted to advance the nomination of **Markwayne Mullin** for homeland security secretary. This decision sparked outrage among some Democrats, who criticized his support for Republican proposals and expressed concerns about his ability to represent his constituents.  Several Democratic lawmakers, including **Brendan Boyle** and **Chrissy Houlahan**, called for Fetterman's removal from office.  Fetterman defended his vote, citing a need for a leader at DHS and disagreements with his Democratic colleagues over funding the department.

recent_articles.title: A true benevolent authoritarian enforces discipline for the greater good: Seeman - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Seeman**, leader of the **Naam Tamilar Katchi (NTK)**, discussed his party's Assembly election manifesto and leadership style in an interview with The Hindu. He advocated for a shift towards an agriculture-centered economy, emphasizing self-sufficiency in food production and job creation through government-led industries.  He also addressed the contradiction between decentralization of power and "benign authoritarianism," arguing that strict discipline is necessary for effective governance. **Seeman** expressed his belief that NTK's goals and ideology are distinct from those of other parties, including alliances with groups like the CPI(M), CPI, VCK, and PMK, which he believes would not align with Tamil nationalist politics.  He emphasized his commitment to a "village-centric" economic growth model, focusing on quality education, healthcare, and clean water as drivers for economic prosperity.

recent_articles.title: Communists fight elections to reflect rights of people, says Brinda Karat - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Brinda Karat**, leader of the **Communist Party of India (Marxist)**, criticized the current government's policies during a public meeting in Chennai. She alleged that the Modi-led government has shifted parliamentary democracy towards "corporate democracy," where corporations donate to the BJP for favorable treatment and access to national assets.  **Karat** also condemned the war against Iran by Israel and the United States, criticizing the government's silence on the issue and its unwillingness to discuss it in Parliament.

recent_articles.title: CAPF Bill says IPS necessary for Union-State coordination, reserves 50% I-G rank posts for IPS - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Central Armed Police Forces (General Administration) Bill, 2026**, which is expected to be tabled in the Rajya Sabha next week, proposes that all ranks of Inspector General and above in **Central Armed Police Forces** (CAPFs) will be filled by Indian Police Service (IPS) officers on deputation. The bill seeks to codify provisions that negate a May 2025 Supreme Court judgment which asked for a reduction in IPS deputation in CAPFs. Retired CAPF officials argue the bill discriminates against cadre officers who won a case after ten years of litigation, while the **Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA)** maintains that the bill is necessary to ensure clarity and operational distinctiveness for these forces.

recent_articles.title: Congress high command will decide Cabinet reshuffle: Home Minister - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **G. Parameshwara**, the **Home Minister** of Karnataka, stated that any decisions regarding cabinet appointments will be made by the **Congress high command** and **Chief Minister Siddaramaiah**. He acknowledged legislators' right to express their desires for ministerial positions but emphasized that the final decision rests with these higher authorities. Several senior Congress MLAs have been seeking cabinet berths, prompting them to meet with **Siddaramaiah** and pressure him for a reshuffle.

recent_articles.title: Will G. Sudhakaran throw a spanner in the Left’s electoral prospects? - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **G. Sudhakaran**, a prominent **CPI(M)** leader in Alappuzha, has announced his candidacy as an Independent after 63 years with the party, citing internal political issues and corruption as reasons for his departure.  His decision is expected to receive support from the Congress-led United Democratic Front (UDF). Political analysts suggest that Sudhakaran's move could have wider implications for the CPI(M) ahead of upcoming Assembly elections, potentially impacting their ability to counter the UDF. The veteran leader argues that he is standing up against political criminals and corruption within the party and aims to appeal to disillusioned cadres while also focusing on local development issues.

recent_articles.title: Suvendu Adhikari accuses Mamata of poll code violation, demands EC action - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Suvendu Adhikari**, leader of the Opposition in the West Bengal Assembly, accused **Mamata Banerjee**, Chief Minister of West Bengal, of violating the Model Code of Conduct by using her official letterhead for political correspondence. He demanded action from the Election Commission and criticized the removal of government hoardings featuring Ms. Banerjee.  **Ms. Banerjee**, in turn, wrote to the Chief Election Commissioner expressing "deep shock" over the functioning of the poll panel and alleging unilateral transfers of senior officials. The West Bengal Assembly elections will be held in two phases on April 23 and 29 with counting scheduled for May 4.

recent_articles.title: Innocent JD(S) workers included in the chargesheet, alleges MLA - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Hassan MLA**, **H.P. Swaroop** of the JD(S) criticized the **SIT's** charge sheet in the case involving former MP, **Prajwal Revanna**, alleging that innocent party workers were included as accused.  **Swaroop** claimed that those truly responsible for the alleged leak of videos and photos have been omitted from the chargesheet. He called for further investigation and urged the government to punish those involved.

recent_articles.title: Jimmy Kimmel on Trump Pearl Harbor joke: ‘Everything he knows about it begins and ends with the Ben Affleck movie’ | Late-night TV roundup | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Late-night hosts discussed **Donald Trump**'s recent diplomatic meetings, including his visit to Japan and meeting with Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi.  **Jimmy Kimmel** on "Jimmy Kimmel Live!" mocked **Trump**'s comments about the Pearl Harbor attack, while **Seth Meyers** on "Late Night" highlighted **Trump**'s claims that he didn't tell allies about the Iran attacks in advance. The hosts also addressed developments in the Epstein investigations and the ongoing government shutdown.  Meanwhile, **Markwayne Mullin** was advanced as a potential homeland security secretary nominee.

recent_articles.title: Trump aides tried to block appointment of Peter Mandelson as UK ambassador to US, reports say – US politics live | Donald Trump | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Donald Trump's** presidential transition team intervened in the UK prime minister **Keir Starmer’s** decision to appoint **Peter Mandelson** as US ambassador, according to reports.  The president's aides expressed dissatisfaction with Mandelson's appointment and sought to retain his predecessor, **Karen Pierce**. The intervention was reportedly made during a meeting in December 2024.  Trump's team also criticized Mandelson for past remarks about the president. This action led to Mandelson's dismissal after nine months.

recent_articles.title: Reform UK suspends Scottish candidate less than a day after announcing him | Reform UK | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Reform UK** has suspended one of its Scottish candidates, Stuart Niven, after he was struck off as a company director for diverting Covid grants. The party faces criticism for fielding candidates with Islamophobic and racist remarks. **Nigel Farage**, the party leader, defended the screening process but admitted that some past comments by candidates may have been "intemperate".  **Anas Sarwar**, the Scottish Labour leader, called the situation a sign of disrespect towards Scots and said Reform is not credible.

recent_articles.title: Uttarakhand gets five new Ministers as Pushkar Dhami expands Cabinet - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami** expanded his cabinet to its full strength of 12 by inducting five new legislators: Bharat Singh Chaudhary, Khajan Dass, Madan Kaushik, Pradeep Batra, and Ram Singh Kaira. The swearing-in ceremony was presided over by **Governor Gurmit Singh**.  The newly appointed ministers include a member of the **BJP national executive** and former state party president, **Kaushik**, as well as first-time entrants to the cabinet.

recent_articles.title: Tories face backlash over anti-Muslim rhetoric - World - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kemi Badenoch**, leader of the **Conservative Party**, defended her shadow justice secretary, **Nick Timothy**, who sparked controversy by calling public prayer "an act of domination" and suggesting it should not be allowed in Trafalgar Square.  **Starmer**, leader of the **Labour Party**, criticized the Conservatives for their stance on Muslims, while **Mayor Sadiq Khan** also expressed disapproval. **Badenoch** argued that religious expression in shared spaces should align with British norms.

recent_articles.title: Attorney general asks if Kemi Badenoch would object to Jewish public prayer | Conservatives | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Richard Hermer**, the attorney general, criticized **Kemi Badenoch**, the Conservative leader, for supporting views that some see as discriminatory against Muslim prayer.  Hermer questioned whether **Badenoch** would object to Jewish prayer in public spaces, citing a similar stance by **Reform UK** and **Tommy Robinson**.  **Badenoch** stated she was uncomfortable with women being pushed to the back during the event but did not specify if her concerns were solely about Islam or any other religious expression.

recent_articles.title: US arts commission approves gold coin stamped with Donald Trump’s face | Donald Trump News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **United States Commission of Fine Arts** unanimously approved plans for a commemorative gold coin featuring Donald Trump's portrait, despite federal law prohibiting depictions of living presidents on currency. The coin is intended as a commemorative item and not for circulation, but critics argue it still violates the law and sets a precedent for future presidential imagery on US coinage.  The **Trump administration** has also advanced plans to put the president’s face on a $1 coin, which are also facing legal challenges.

recent_articles.title: Design for commemorative Trump coin in 24-karat gold approved by appointees | Donald Trump | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **US Commission of Fine Arts** approved the final design for a 24-karat gold commemorative coin featuring **Donald Trump's** image to celebrate the US’s 250th birthday. The coin, whose size and denomination are still under discussion, will be produced by the **US Mint** after approval from the treasury secretary.  The front of the coin depicts **Trump** in a suit and tie with a stern look on his face, while the reverse side features an eagle in flight.

recent_articles.title: Delhi HC issues notice on plea seeking removal of India’s patent head - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Delhi High Court** issued notice to the **Centre** and **Prof. Unnat P. Pandit**, the **Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks (CGPDTM)**, in response to a petition challenging his appointment. The **All India Patent Officers’ Welfare Association (AIPOWA)** filed the plea alleging that Mr. Pandit's appointment was illegal and violated government norms regarding eligibility criteria and selection processes.  The High Court has listed the matter for further hearing in May.

recent_articles.title: Why the US Homeland Security shutdown is raising fears of airport delays | Government News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The partial US government shutdown, which began on February 14th, has caused significant disruptions at airports due to a lack of funding for the Transportation Security Administration (TSA). **Congress** is debating funding for the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), with Democrats demanding changes to immigration enforcement policies and Republicans rejecting those demands. The shutdown has led to missed paychecks for TSA workers, prompting some to resign or take unscheduled leave, resulting in long lines and delays at airports.  Airlines are urging **Congress** to end the shutdown, citing its impact on airport operations and passenger experience.

recent_articles.title: Book offering behind-the-scenes glimpse of political strategy launched - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Minister for Information Technology and Digital Services Palanivel Thiaga Rajan** spoke at the launch of a new book, "Inside the War Room: How Power is Built, Fought and Won," by entrepreneur Aspire K. Swaminathan.  The book explores political strategy through real-world scenarios and was praised by **Karti P. Chidambaram**, who received the first copy. **Chidambaram** emphasized the importance of empathy in politics and strategic decision-making for success.

recent_articles.title: ‘Family first’ in BJP list of bypoll candidates in Nagaland, Tripura - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** has chosen candidates for upcoming by-elections in Nagaland and Tripura, reflecting a dynastic trend.  Daochier Imchen will represent the Koridang seat in Nagaland, following his father's death, while Jahar Chakraborti is the BJP candidate from Dharmanagar, Tripura. The decisions follow the deaths of previous representatives in both constituencies. **Rashik Goswami**, a former BJP candidate for the Dharmanagar seat, and **Biswa Bandhu Sen**, who switched parties to join the BJP before winning the 2018 election, also died recently.  The party has announced candidates for by-elections in Goa, Karnataka, and Karnataka as well.

recent_articles.title: Cryptocurrency firms suffer heavy losses in Illinois primaries after spending big | Cryptocurrencies | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The cryptocurrency industry, aiming to replicate its success in the 2024 midterm elections, saw mixed results in Illinois primaries. **Fairshake**, a crypto-backed political action committee, spent millions against Democratic candidates who supported state-level crypto regulations, while AI firms like **Think Big Pac** and **Jobs and Democracy Pac** invested in opposing candidates. Despite spending large sums of money, the industry's efforts to influence elections were met with mixed results, highlighting the challenges of establishing a clear political presence.

recent_articles.title: Rama Duwaji: Did Rama Duwaji use the N-word? Old posts of NYC first lady spark backlash - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rama Duwaji**, the wife of New York City mayor **Zohran Mamdani**, is facing backlash over resurfaced social media posts from years ago. The posts, allegedly made on platforms like Tumblr and X, contain controversial language and views on race, politics, and international issues. Some posts include a racial slur from 2013, while others express support for Palestinian causes and criticism of US foreign policy. **Mamdani** has defended his wife's privacy, stating she is a private individual not holding any official position in the city government. The controversy comes just months after Duwaji became New York City’s first lady.

recent_articles.title: Palaniswami meets Shah in Delhi to discuss sharing of seats - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Edappadi K. Palaniswami**, general secretary of the **AIADMK**, met with **Amit Shah**, Union Home Minister and BJP strategist, to finalize seat-sharing arrangements for the upcoming Tamil Nadu Assembly election. The meeting is expected to be followed by a briefing from **Palaniswami** on Friday.  **T.T.V. Dhinakaran**, founder of the AMMK, will travel to New Delhi, potentially to participate in the discussions.

recent_articles.title: Supreme privilege to touch the sacred dust of Ayodhya, says President Murmu - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **President Droupadi Murmu** and **Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath** attended the installation of the Shri Ram Yantra at the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Mandir in Ayodhya.  **Murmu** emphasized that the ideal of Ram Rajya represents economic prosperity and social harmony, while **Adityanath** highlighted the joy and faith this event has brought to followers of Sanatan Dharma. He also criticized opposition parties for disrespecting Lord Ram's faith.

recent_articles.title: Kemi Badenoch backs Nick Timothy after he calls Islamic public prayers ‘act of domination’ | Conservatives | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kemi Badenoch**, shadow justice secretary **Nick Timothy's** supporter, defended his controversial comments about Islamic prayers in public spaces.  She acknowledged the country's tolerance of minority faiths but argued that religious expression in shared public spaces must align with British culture.  Badenoch stated that such expressions should be "in conformity with our values, our norms, our beliefs" and sometimes require adjustments to ensure inclusivity. **Sadiq Khan**, London mayor, criticized Timothy's views while **Anna Turley**, Labour party chair, condemned the Conservatives for embracing prejudice against Muslims.

recent_articles.title: Scholars predict political shifts amid governance concerns at BRS Ugadi celebrations - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Renowned scholars**, Mrutyunjaya Sharma and Phanindra Sharma, presented their annual astrological forecast at the Sri Parabhava Nama Samvatsara Ugadi Panchanga Sravanam in Telangana. The forecast predicted a year of potential political instability due to governance shortcomings and administrative failures, which could strengthen the Opposition significantly.  However, favorable weather conditions were expected, including full reservoirs and tanks, leading to good crop yields.

recent_articles.title: Senate committee advances Markwayne Mullin’s nomination to lead homeland security | Trump administration | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Senate** committee on homeland security and governmental affairs advanced the nomination of **Markwayne Mullin** to lead the **Department of Homeland Security (DHS)** in a near party-line vote.  While nearly all Republicans supported the nomination, Democrat **John Fetterman** was the lone Democrat to support it. The nomination will now be considered by the full Senate, where Republicans appear poised to confirm him. Committee Democrats expressed concerns about Mullin's approach to immigration enforcement and his willingness to condone political violence.

recent_articles.title: KPCC chief’s brother joins BJP in Kannur - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Shaji V. Joseph**, brother of **Sunny Joseph**, the president of the **Kerala Pradesh Congress Committee (KPCC)**, joined the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** in Kannur on Thursday.  He was formally inducted by **Sadanand Shet Tanavade**, former Goa BJP president and Rajya Sabha MP. **Joseph** cited "development-oriented politics" as his reason for leaving the Congress party, stating he had been drawn to **Narendra Modi**.

recent_articles.title: Jemima responds to Tarar, says govt wants Imran’s sons to travel on Nicops so they will ‘not have British protection’ - Pakistan - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Jemima Goldsmith**, former spouse of **Imran Khan**, accused the government of recommending that his sons travel to Pakistan using National Identity Cards for Overseas Pakistanis (Nicops) to avoid British protection.  She made this statement in response to **Information Minister Attaullah Tarar**, who suggested visa-free entry for Imran’s children, provided they comply with Pakistani laws. **Jemima** previously appealed to Prime Minister **Shehbaz Sharif** about the delayed visa processing for her sons, Kasim and Suleiman, who are currently living in London.

recent_articles.title: Bernardi vows to pay for flights taken with Hanson on Rinehart’s plane amid confusion about SA’s donations ban | Australian political donations | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Cory Bernardi** and **Pauline Hanson**, the lead candidate for the **One Nation** party in South Australia's state election, are facing scrutiny over potential breaches of the state's new political donation laws.  Hanson acknowledged receiving flights from **Gina Rinehart's** company S Kidman & Co., but claims they were paid for by **Bernardi**. The new legislation prohibits donations to parties and candidates, with some exceptions, and has been met with mixed reactions. While **Tammy Franks**, an independent candidate, argues the laws are designed to prevent billionaire influence, others question their application in this case.  The electoral commission declined to comment on the flights but stated that registered political parties can accept donations up to a specified limit.
